entryPointCandidates.name: app.py
entryPointCandidates.summary: Main FastAPI application module: defines the app instance, lifespan startup (DB init + sequential schema migrations), CDISC Library concept/specialization fetch-and-cache endpoints, SoA matrix build/render logic, and the bulk of the SoA edit page's inline UI endpoints (cells, superscripts, elements, transition rules) plus XLSX/HTML/PDF/CSV export.

entryPointCandidates.name: audit.py
entryPointCandidates.summary: Central audit-trail module providing before/after change-logging helper functions for every mutable entity type in the SoA workbench (visits, activities, elements, timings, schedule timelines, instances, amendments, organizations, roles, persons, and more), each writing a row to the entity's audit table using the supplied database cursor.

entryPointCandidates.name: activities.py
entryPointCandidates.summary: FastAPI router for Activity CRUD, bulk creation, and reordering, plus CDISC Biomedical Concept fetching/association and the DSS (Dataset Specialization) and CRF specialization cell rendering used by the SoA matrix UI.

entryPointCandidates.name: elements.py
entryPointCandidates.summary: FastAPI router for StudyElement CRUD (structural design periods/cohorts), transition-rule and study-intervention associations, and the element audit-history endpoint.

entryPointCandidates.name: schedule_timelines.py
entryPointCandidates.summary: FastAPI router for ScheduleTimeline CRUD (main/branch timeline containers) plus the consolidated Study Timing overview page aggregating instances, decision instances, timings, and condition assignments.

list.name: API Layer
list.description: FastAPI router modules under web/routers/ implementing the domain-specific REST and HTMX UI endpoints (visits, activities, arms, epochs, elements, amendments, estimands, terminology browsers, freezes, USDM/DAIR export, and more).

list.name: Presentation Layer
list.description: Jinja2/HTMX HTML templates and static assets (CSS, JS, help pages) that render the SoA Workbench UI and are swapped into the page by router responses.

list.name: Types Layer
list.description: Pydantic request/response models in web/schemas.py, imported across nearly all routers to validate and shape API payloads.

list.name: Service Layer
list.description: Shared business-logic helpers and the cross-cutting audit trail (web/utils.py, web/audit.py) that routers call into for common operations and before/after change logging.

list.name: Data Layer
list.description: SQLite persistence: the canonical connection helper (db.py), schema initialization, and migration runner that every router and generator depends on for storage.

list.name: Configuration Layer
list.description: Application bootstrap and settings: the FastAPI app factory/lifespan wiring (app.py) and CDISC CT codelist configuration (codelist_config.py) that drive UI dropdown behavior.

list.name: CLI / Legacy Pipeline Layer
list.description: The original normalize/expand/validate command-line pipeline (cli.py, normalization.py, schedule.py, validation.py) and the package root, still used by the web layer's USDM generation flows.

list.name: Integration Layer
list.description: The Model Context Protocol server (mcp/server.py) that exposes SoA Workbench data and operations as tools for external MCP clients.

file:web/audit.py.name: audit.py
file:web/audit.py.summary: Central audit-trail module providing before/after change-logging helper functions for every mutable entity type in the SoA workbench (visits, activities, elements, timings, schedule timelines, instances, amendments, organizations, roles, persons, and more), each writing a row to the entity's audit table using the supplied database cursor.

file:web/routers/activities.py.name: activities.py
file:web/routers/activities.py.summary: FastAPI router for Activity CRUD, bulk creation, and reordering, plus CDISC Biomedical Concept fetching/association and the DSS (Dataset Specialization) and CRF specialization cell rendering used by the SoA matrix UI.

file:web/routers/bc_surrogates.py.name: bc_surrogates.py
file:web/routers/bc_surrogates.py.summary: FastAPI router managing BC (Biomedical Concept) Surrogate entities and their links to activities, including the concepts-cell HTMX partial that renders surrogate/BC assignments in the SoA matrix.

file:web/routers/cells.py.name: cells.py
file:web/routers/cells.py.summary: FastAPI router for StudyCell CRUD (arm/epoch/element junction entities) and cell reordering, backing the API and HTMX UI endpoints of the SoA design matrix.

file:web/routers/condition_assignments.p.name: condition_assignments.py
file:web/routers/condition_assignments.p.summary: FastAPI router for ConditionAssignment CRUD, mapping decision-instance branch conditions to their target instances, with matching API and HTMX UI endpoints.

file:web/routers/decision_instances.py.name: decision_instances.py
file:web/routers/decision_instances.py.summary: FastAPI router for DecisionInstance CRUD and reordering — the branch points in a ScheduleTimeline that route subjects based on ConditionAssignments.

file:web/routers/elements.py.name: elements.py
file:web/routers/elements.py.summary: FastAPI router for StudyElement CRUD (structural design periods/cohorts), transition-rule and study-intervention associations, and the element audit-history endpoint.

file:web/routers/footnotes.py.name: footnotes.py
file:web/routers/footnotes.py.summary: FastAPI router for Footnote CRUD used to annotate SoA matrix cells and activities with reference text.

file:web/routers/instances.py.name: instances.py
file:web/routers/instances.py.summary: FastAPI router for ScheduledActivityInstance CRUD and reordering — the temporal visit/timepoint occurrences within a ScheduleTimeline.

file:web/routers/persons.py.name: persons.py
file:web/routers/persons.py.summary: FastAPI router for Person CRUD plus role/organization assignment-conflict validation, backing the combined Organizations/Roles/Persons UI page.

file:web/routers/rules.py.name: rules.py
file:web/routers/rules.py.summary: FastAPI router for transition-rule (reusable business-rule text) CRUD used as start/end rule references by elements and visits.

file:web/routers/schedule_timelines.py.name: schedule_timelines.py
file:web/routers/schedule_timelines.py.summary: FastAPI router for ScheduleTimeline CRUD (main/branch timeline containers) plus the consolidated Study Timing overview page aggregating instances, decision instances, timings, and condition assignments.

file:web/routers/study_identifiers.py.name: study_identifiers.py
file:web/routers/study_identifiers.py.summary: FastAPI router for StudyIdentifier CRUD, linking scoping organizations to study identifier values such as the NCT number.

file:web/routers/timings.py.name: timings.py
file:web/routers/timings.py.summary: FastAPI router for StudyTiming CRUD, including ISO 8601 duration/window validation and relative-to-instance scheduling used to compute visit timing windows.

file:web/routers/visits.py.name: visits.py
file:web/routers/visits.py.summary: FastAPI router for Visit (Encounter) CRUD, reordering, transition rules, and environmental-setting/contact-mode code-list associations.

file:web/schemas.py.name: schemas.py
file:web/schemas.py.summary: Central Pydantic request-validation schema module defining Create/Update payload models for every mutable USDM entity in the application (activities, elements, visits, timings, arms, epochs, amendments, and more), including ISO 8601 duration and timing-window consistency validators.

file:web/app.py.name: app.py
file:web/app.py.summary: Main FastAPI application module: defines the app instance, lifespan startup (DB init + sequential schema migrations), CDISC Library concept/specialization fetch-and-cache endpoints, SoA matrix build/render logic, and the bulk of the SoA edit page's inline UI endpoints (cells, superscripts, elements, transition rules) plus XLSX/HTML/PDF/CSV export.

file:web/db.py.name: db.py
file:web/db.py.summary: Canonical SQLite connection helper used throughout the web app; resolves the DB path (auto-selecting the test DB under pytest) and opens a connection with WAL mode and a busy timeout.

file:web/initialize_database.py.name: initialize_database.py
file:web/initialize_database.py.summary: Defines `_init_db`, a single large function that creates every core SQLite table (studies, arms, epochs, visits, activities, cells, timelines, instances, audits, and related entities) on a fresh database.

file:web/migrate_database.py.name: migrate_database.py
file:web/migrate_database.py.summary: Library of ~108 small, idempotent schema-migration functions (new columns, new tables, audit tables, backfills, data repairs) that are individually imported and invoked by `app.py`'s lifespan startup to incrementally evolve the SQLite schema across releases.

file:web/routers/_freeze_helpers.py.name: _freeze_helpers.py
file:web/routers/_freeze_helpers.py.summary: Core implementation behind the SoA freeze/versioning system: captures point-in-time snapshots of every study entity (arms, timings, objectives, endpoints, encounters, cells, timelines, instances, BCs, amendments), computes structural diffs between two freezes, and performs freeze rollback.

file:web/routers/amendments.py.name: amendments.py
file:web/routers/amendments.py.summary: FastAPI router implementing CRUD for protocol amendments and their sub-entities (secondary reasons, impacts, changes with document-content-reference sections, geographic scopes, subject enrollments, governance dates), each tied to a freeze.

file:web/routers/audits.py.name: audits.py
file:web/routers/audits.py.summary: FastAPI router rendering a single combined audit-trail history page that aggregates before/after change records across every auditable entity type in a SoA.

file:web/routers/bc_categories.py.name: bc_categories.py
file:web/routers/bc_categories.py.summary: FastAPI router for assigning and removing CDISC BC (Biomedical Concept) classification categories on an activity, expanding a category into its constituent concepts on assignment.

file:web/routers/dair.py.name: dair.py
file:web/routers/dair.py.summary: FastAPI router serving the Digital Amendment Impact Report (DAIR) UI page and its downloadable DOCX report comparing a base and revised freeze.

file:web/routers/freezes.py.name: freezes.py
file:web/routers/freezes.py.summary: FastAPI router exposing the freeze lifecycle (list, create with optional amendment metadata, view, diff, rollback, delete) as thin HTTP endpoints over `_freeze_helpers` and `amendments` internals.

file:web/routers/organizations.py.name: organizations.py
file:web/routers/organizations.py.summary: FastAPI router implementing CRUD for study Organization entities, including organization-type and country controlled-terminology code management and structured address fields.

file:web/routers/roles.py.name: roles.py
file:web/routers/roles.py.summary: FastAPI router implementing CRUD for study Role entities, including role-type controlled-terminology codes, organization linkage, person assignment, masking flags, and conflict validation between role/org/person combinations.

file:web/routers/soa_bundle.py.name: soa_bundle.py
file:web/routers/soa_bundle.py.summary: FastAPI router for exporting and importing an entire SoA study as a self-contained JSON bundle covering all related tables, enabling backup, cloning, or transfer of a study between databases.

file:web/routers/usdm_json.py.name: usdm_json.py
file:web/routers/usdm_json.py.summary: FastAPI router serving generated USDM JSON, the Define-JSON view, and per-component USDM downloads for a SoA, delegating actual generation to the `usdm` package's generators.

file:web/routers/cdash_terminology.py.name: cdash_terminology.py
file:web/routers/cdash_terminology.py.summary: FastAPI router exposing a JSON API and HTMX UI page for browsing the cached CDASH Controlled Terminology package sourced from the CDISC Library, with search, code/codelist filtering, and pagination.

file:web/routers/ddf_controlled_terminol.name: ddf_controlled_terminology.py
file:web/routers/ddf_controlled_terminol.summary: FastAPI router exposing a JSON API and HTMX UI page for browsing the cached DDF (Digital Data Flow) Controlled Terminology package from the CDISC Library, with search, filtering, and pagination.

file:web/routers/define_xml_terminology..name: define_xml_terminology.py
file:web/routers/define_xml_terminology..summary: FastAPI router exposing a JSON API and HTMX UI page for browsing the cached Define-XML Controlled Terminology package from the CDISC Library, with search, filtering, and pagination.

file:web/routers/concept_groups.py.name: concept_groups.py
file:web/routers/concept_groups.py.summary: Large FastAPI router managing custom Concept Groups (CRUD on groups, member concepts, category/surrogate assignment to activities) and a proxy/sync layer to the external BC Grouping microservice that materializes CDISC classification schemes as concept_group rows (source='cdisc') alongside user-authored custom groups.

file:web/routers/estimands.py.name: estimands.py
file:web/routers/estimands.py.summary: FastAPI router providing full CRUD for USDM Estimands within a SoA: estimand records, their outcome/endpoint variables, intercurrent events and handling strategies, and associated study interventions, with both JSON API and HTMX UI endpoints.

file:web/routers/indications.py.name: indications.py
file:web/routers/indications.py.summary: FastAPI router providing full CRUD for USDM Indications within a SoA, including disease/condition coding (code system, version, decode), with both JSON API and HTMX UI endpoints. Its `_list_indications` helper is reused by the estimands router.

file:web/routers/protocol_controlled_ter.name: protocol_controlled_terminology.py
file:web/routers/protocol_controlled_ter.summary: FastAPI router exposing a JSON API and HTMX UI page for browsing the cached ICH M11 Protocol Controlled Terminology package from the CDISC Library, with search, filtering, and pagination.

file:web/routers/rollback.py.name: rollback.py
file:web/routers/rollback.py.summary: FastAPI router exposing JSON, HTMX, and XLSX-export views over the rollback and reorder audit trails maintained by the app module, letting users inspect and export the history of freeze rollbacks and drag-and-drop reordering actions for a SoA.

file:web/routers/sdtm_terminology.py.name: sdtm_terminology.py
file:web/routers/sdtm_terminology.py.summary: FastAPI router exposing a JSON API and HTMX UI page for browsing the cached SDTM Controlled Terminology package from the CDISC Library, with search, filtering, and pagination.

file:web/routers/tdd.py.name: tdd.py
file:web/routers/tdd.py.summary: FastAPI router generating SDTM Trial Design Domains (TA/Trial Arms, TE/Trial Elements, TV/Trial Visits) from the SoA's arms, elements, and visits, exposing JSON dataset views, a define-XML style column metadata browser page, and CSV download.

file:web/utils.py.name: utils.py
file:web/utils.py.summary: Large shared utility module for the web layer: CDISC Library API integration (cached fetch/refresh of epoch types, environmental settings, contact modes, and SDTM/CDASH/Define-XML/Protocol/DDF Controlled Terminology packages), monotonic UID generators for dozens of USDM entity types, USDM/database lookup helpers (timing, encounters, epochs, schedule timelines), and misc helpers (ISO-8601 duration parsing, referer-based redirects).

file:web/codelist_config.py.name: codelist_config.py
file:web/codelist_config.py.summary: Defines CDISC controlled-terminology codelist code constants (epoch type, arm type, role type, objective/endpoint level, intervention role/type/unit, etc.) that back UI dropdowns, each overridable via a CODELIST_* environment variable in config.env.

file:web/routers/arms.py.name: arms.py
file:web/routers/arms.py.summary: FastAPI router providing API and HTMX UI endpoints for managing Study Arms (StudyArm USDM entity): create/list/update/delete, arm reordering, and CDISC CT-backed arm type / data-origin type coding.

file:web/routers/endpoints.py.name: endpoints.py
file:web/routers/endpoints.py.summary: FastAPI router managing Endpoint entities linked to Study Objectives, exposing API and HTMX UI create/update/delete endpoints with CDISC CT-backed endpoint-level coding.

file:web/routers/epochs.py.name: epochs.py
file:web/routers/epochs.py.summary: FastAPI router for managing Study Epochs (StudyEpoch USDM entity): CRUD, epoch-type coding via CDISC CT, epoch metadata updates, and drag-and-drop reordering, with an internal per-field audit-trail helper.

file:web/routers/objectives.py.name: objectives.py
file:web/routers/objectives.py.summary: FastAPI router managing Study Objectives (Objective USDM entity) together with their linked Endpoints, providing API and HTMX UI CRUD endpoints and CDISC CT-backed objective/endpoint level coding.

file:web/routers/study_interventions.py.name: study_interventions.py
file:web/routers/study_interventions.py.summary: FastAPI router managing Study Interventions (StudyIntervention USDM entity), including role/type/dose coding across multiple CDISC CT packages (DDF, Protocol, SDTM) and per-intervention CT code/alias sub-entities.

file:web/routers/study_titles.py.name: study_titles.py
file:web/routers/study_titles.py.summary: FastAPI router managing Study Titles (StudyTitle USDM entity) with CDISC CT-backed title-type coding, exposing both JSON API and HTMX UI create/delete endpoints.

file:__init__.py.name: __init__.py
file:__init__.py.summary: Package entry point for soa_builder that re-exports the core legacy pipeline functions (normalize_soa, expand_schedule_rules, validate_imaging_schedule) as the public API via __all__.

file:cli.py.name: cli.py

file:schedule.py.name: schedule.py
file:schedule.py.summary: Expands normalized schedule rules (cyclical, weekly, daily patterns) into concrete projected activity occurrences across a study horizon, given a start date and cycle configuration.

file:validation.py.name: validation.py
file:validation.py.summary: Extracts imaging-related visit/activity events from normalized rows and validates that consecutive imaging events fall within an expected interval tolerance, used by the CLI validate command.

file:web/templates/edit.html.summary: Main SoA editing page rendering the study metadata form, activities/instances CRUD sections, and the large timeline-aware activity/instance matrix with per-cell toggling, footnotes management, and Excel/HTML export links.

file:web/templates/element_audit_section.name: element_audit_section.html
file:web/templates/element_audit_section.summary: Small collapsible partial rendering the most recent StudyElement audit trail entries (action, timestamp, before/after JSON) in a table.

file:web/templates/elements.html.name: elements.html
file:web/templates/elements.html.summary: CRUD page for StudyElement records, letting users create elements and edit their name, label, description, transition start/end rules, and linked interventions.

file:web/templates/encounters.html.name: encounters.html
file:web/templates/encounters.html.summary: CRUD page for Encounter (visit) records with fields for scheduled timing, environmental setting, contact mode, and transition rules, plus drag-free up/down row reordering with a save-order action.

file:web/templates/epochs.html.name: epochs.html
file:web/templates/epochs.html.summary: CRUD page for StudyEpoch records supporting create, inline edit/save, delete, and manual up/down reordering with an order-persistence endpoint call.

file:web/templates/estimands.html.name: estimands.html
file:web/templates/estimands.html.summary: Page for managing study Estimands and Indications, combining the estimands and indications partials with HTMX-driven add forms for each.

file:web/templates/estimands_partial.htm.name: estimands_partial.html
file:web/templates/estimands_partial.htm.summary: HTMX-swappable partial listing estimands with nested subsections for linked variables of interest (endpoints), linked interventions, and intercurrent events, each with inline link/add/delete forms.

file:web/templates/freeze_modal.html.name: freeze_modal.html
file:web/templates/freeze_modal.html.summary: Standalone modal fragment rendered directly by the freezes router for three modes: viewing a frozen snapshot, diffing two snapshots (visits/activities/cells/concepts/USDM entities), and previewing a rollback.

file:web/templates/freezes.html.name: freezes.html
file:web/templates/freezes.html.summary: Snapshot/amendment management page listing frozen SoA versions with view, rollback-preview, JSON download, and delete actions, plus a version comparison selector and audit log links.

file:web/templates/help.html.name: help.html
file:web/templates/help.html.summary: Static step-by-step help guide describing the workflow for building an SoA matrix, from creating a study through epochs, arms, elements, encounters, and USDM JSON generation.

file:web/templates/index.html.name: index.html
file:web/templates/index.html.summary: Landing page listing existing studies with create-new-study and import-from-bundle forms, plus a confirmation modal (typed Study ID/name match) for deleting a study.

file:web/templates/indications_partial.h.name: indications_partial.html
file:web/templates/indications_partial.h.summary: HTMX-swappable partial listing study Indications with a rare-disease flag and a nested per-indication Codes subsection supporting add/delete of coded terms.

file:web/templates/instances.html.name: instances.html
file:web/templates/instances.html.summary: Thin wrapper page that extends the base layout and includes the shared scheduled-instances section partial.

file:web/templates/objectives.html.name: objectives.html
file:web/templates/objectives.html.summary: CRUD page for Objectives and their child Endpoints, grouping endpoints under their parent objective and surfacing a separate reassignment table for orphaned endpoints.

file:web/templates/organizations_oob_res.name: organizations_oob_response.html
file:web/templates/organizations_oob_res.summary: HTMX out-of-band response fragment that re-renders the organizations, roles, and persons partials together after an organizations-related mutation (roles/persons flagged for OOB swap).

file:web/templates/organizations_partial.name: organizations_partial.html
file:web/templates/organizations_partial.summary: HTMX-swappable partial for CRUD of study Organizations, including type/country dropdowns with hidden decode fields and an add-organization form with full address fields.

file:web/templates/orgs_roles_persons.ht.name: orgs_roles_persons.html
file:web/templates/orgs_roles_persons.ht.summary: Page combining the Organizations, Roles, and Persons management partials under a single study-scoped view.

file:web/templates/persons_oob_response..name: persons_oob_response.html
file:web/templates/persons_oob_response..summary: HTMX out-of-band response fragment that re-renders the persons and roles partials together after a persons-related mutation.

file:web/templates/persons_partial.html.name: persons_partial.html
file:web/templates/persons_partial.html.summary: HTMX-swappable partial for CRUD of study PersonName records (job title, family/given names, prefixes/suffixes) with an organization-link dropdown.

file:web/templates/protocol_controlled_t.name: protocol_controlled_terminology.html
file:web/templates/protocol_controlled_t.summary: Browse/search page for Protocol Controlled Terminology, offering filter fields (search, code, codelist name/code, limit), a refresh-from-CDISC-Library action, and paginated results table.

file:web/templates/reorder_audit_modal.h.name: reorder_audit_modal.html
file:web/templates/reorder_audit_modal.h.summary: Modal partial that displays the audit log of manual drag-and-drop reordering operations for visits and activities, showing old/new order-index sequences per entity.

file:web/templates/roles_partial.html.name: roles_partial.html
file:web/templates/roles_partial.html.summary: HTMX partial rendering the study roles table (with organization/person assignment and masking flags) plus an inline add-role form; swapped into #roles-section on create/update/delete.

file:web/templates/rollback_audit_modal..name: rollback_audit_modal.html
file:web/templates/rollback_audit_modal..summary: Modal partial showing the audit log of freeze-rollback operations, listing restored visit/activity/cell/concept counts per rollback event.

file:web/templates/rules.html.name: rules.html
file:web/templates/rules.html.summary: Full page for creating and managing study transition rules (name, label, description, rule text) with inline save/delete forms per row.

file:web/templates/schedule_timelines.ht.name: schedule_timelines.html
file:web/templates/schedule_timelines.ht.summary: Thin page wrapper that extends the base layout and includes the schedule timelines section partial as its sole content.

file:web/templates/sdtm_specialization_d.name: sdtm_specialization_detail.html
file:web/templates/sdtm_specialization_d.summary: Detail view for a single CDISC Library SDTM Dataset Specialization, rendering its variable table, summary key/value pairs, and raw JSON payload with error/missing-key diagnostics.

file:web/templates/sdtm_specializations..name: sdtm_specializations.html
file:web/templates/sdtm_specializations..summary: List view of CDISC Library SDTM dataset specializations with client-side search filtering, a refresh action, and links into per-item detail pages.

file:web/templates/sdtm_specializations_.name: sdtm_specializations_status.html
file:web/templates/sdtm_specializations_.summary: Diagnostics page showing cache status for the SDTM specializations fetch (count, fetch time, cache age, last error/URL, API key presence) and a raw sample payload.

file:web/templates/sdtm_terminology.html.name: sdtm_terminology.html
file:web/templates/sdtm_terminology.html.summary: Controlled terminology browser for SDTM, providing filter fields (search, code, codelist name/code, limit), a paginated results table, and a refresh-from-CDISC-Library action.

file:web/templates/soa_matrix_export.htm.name: soa_matrix_export.html
file:web/templates/soa_matrix_export.htm.summary: Standalone, self-contained HTML document (not extending base.html) for print/export rendering of the full SoA matrix across schedule timelines, with embedded CSS and expandable concept/surrogate detail per activity.

file:web/templates/study_cells.html.name: study_cells.html
file:web/templates/study_cells.html.summary: Page for managing study cells (arm + epoch + element junctions), with a creation form and a reorderable table supporting row move-up/down and a persisted custom order.

file:web/templates/study_identifiers_par.name: study_identifiers_partial.html
file:web/templates/study_identifiers_par.summary: HTMX partial listing study identifiers (e.g. NCT numbers) with delete actions, and an add-identifier form with an organization scope selector.

file:web/templates/study_interventions.h.name: study_interventions.html
file:web/templates/study_interventions.h.summary: Page for creating study interventions (name, label, description, role/type/duration codes) that includes the interventions partial to render the existing list.

file:web/templates/study_interventions_p.name: study_interventions_partial.html
file:web/templates/study_interventions_p.summary: HTMX partial rendering the study interventions table with role/type/duration columns, delete actions, and a nested per-intervention codes sub-table with its own add-code form.

file:web/templates/study_timing.html.name: study_timing.html
file:web/templates/study_timing.html.summary: Composite study-timing dashboard page assembling five collapsible sections (schedule timelines, scheduled activity instances, scheduled decision instances, condition assignments, timings) via includes, with collapse-state persisted in localStorage.

file:web/templates/study_titles_partial..name: study_titles_partial.html
file:web/templates/study_titles_partial..summary: HTMX partial listing study titles with type decode labels and delete actions, plus an add-title form with a type-code dropdown that syncs a hidden decode field.

file:web/templates/tdd.html.name: tdd.html
file:web/templates/tdd.html.summary: Page listing generatable SDTM Trial Design Domains with per-domain JSON/CSV download links and an in-page HTMX-driven preview action.

file:web/templates/tdd_view_partial.html.name: tdd_view_partial.html
file:web/templates/tdd_view_partial.html.summary: HTMX partial that renders a preview table of generated Trial Design Domain records for one domain, swapped into the #tdd-preview target with a close button.

file:web/templates/timings.html.name: timings.html
file:web/templates/timings.html.summary: Thin page wrapper that extends the base layout and includes the timings section partial as its sole content.

file:web/templates/transition_rules_list.name: transition_rules_list.html
file:web/templates/transition_rules_list.summary: Standalone HTMX partial rendering an ordered list of transition rules with inline save and delete forms per rule, swapped into #transition-rule-list.

file:mcp/__init__.py.name: __init__.py
file:mcp/__init__.py.summary: Empty package marker file that makes soa_builder.mcp a Python package for the MCP server module.

file:mcp/server.py.name: server.py
file:mcp/server.py.summary: MCP (Model Context Protocol) server exposing 11 tools over stdio for interacting with the SoA workbench: listing/creating SoAs, visits, and activities, assigning activities to scheduled instances, retrieving the visits-by-activities matrix, and generating USDM/Define-JSON documents. Registered as the `soa-mcp` console script and picked up by Claude Code via `.mcp.json`.

file:web/static/bc_explorer.js.name: bc_explorer.js
file:web/static/bc_explorer.js.summary: Client-side script driving the CDISC Biomedical Concept (BC) Grouping Explorer UI: filters and renders BC cards/matrix views by scheme facets and search query, and manages a detail panel showing related concepts. Consumes a server-seeded global `BC_DATA` object rather than fetching or importing data itself.

file:web/static/help/bc_groupings.html.name: bc_groupings.html
file:web/static/help/bc_groupings.html.summary: Standalone pandoc-generated help page explaining Biomedical Concept Groupings: how groups tag related BCs, are created at the UX layer independent of any single SoA, can be assigned to or removed from an Activity, and support copy/inheritance between groups.

file:web/static/help/bc_workflow.html.name: bc_workflow.html
file:web/static/help/bc_workflow.html.summary: Standalone pandoc-generated help page walking through the workflow for linking a Biomedical Concept (and Biomedical Concept Surrogate) to an Activity/Scheduled Activity Instance in the SoA Matrix, illustrated with screenshots.

file:web/static/style.css.name: style.css
file:web/static/style.css.summary: Shared design-system stylesheet for the whole soa-workbench web UI, defining the `am-` (atomic utility) and `fz-` (freeze/component) class conventions used across templates: layout grids, form controls, buttons, data tables, change/audit cards, and spacing/typography utilities.

file:web/templates/usdm_json.html.name: usdm_json.html
file:web/templates/usdm_json.html.summary: Jinja template rendering the USDM JSON generation page for a study: a table of downloadable USDM components (arms, activities, encounters, etc.) each linking to its component-specific JSON download endpoint.

file:web/templates/usdm_model_explorer.h.name: usdm_model_explorer.html
file:web/templates/usdm_model_explorer.h.summary: Self-contained interactive USDM v4.0.0 Model Explorer page embedding the full USDM class/attribute reference data inline as a JSON literal (sourced from dataStructure.yml, USDM_UML.xmi, USDM_API JSON, USDM_CT.xlsx, and the LZZT pilot study), with its own browse/search UI and scoped styling independent of the shared app stylesheet.
